name: Peugeot
intro: Peugeot originated in France. This course teaches selected recognizable model families, organized by the jobs they do. It is a guided starting map, not a claim that these are every current or historical model.
naming: Peugeot is a French brand, recognized by its lion identity. Its model names often use numbers, but the numbers are family names rather than literal engine sizes. This course uses international recognition examples, not a Canadian new-car price list.
warning: The families below are selected for learning and recognition. Check the linked official range for current Canadian availability, model years, equipment and pricing. A familiar name may remain on used cars after new-car availability changes.

models.name: 208 & E-208
models.explanation: 208 is a small Peugeot hatchback family; E-208 names an electric version family. These are useful international recognition examples, not a claim of ordinary new-car availability in Canada.
models.tradeoff: The 208 & E-208 belongs in a comparison for small peugeot hatchback. Check actual passenger fit, cargo access, exterior dimensions and the exact version’s running costs. Its category is a starting point, not a promise that it fits every person or task.
models.compare: Compare energy source, exact generation and body before using an overseas review. Do not convert a UK headline price into a Canadian dealer quote.
models.scenario: A friend mentions a 208 & E-208. Explain its role as small peugeot hatchback, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Peugeot.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.

models.explanation: 308 is a larger passenger-car family than 208, with body and powertrain variants that depend on market and year. Estate is another word for wagon.

models.scenario: A friend mentions a 308. Explain its role as larger peugeot passenger-car family, then ask for the year, powertrain and equipment before comparing it with another Peugeot.
models.power: Check the exact Canadian model year and version for the available engine, hybrid or electric system. Do not infer the powertrain from the family name alone.

models.name: 3008 & E-3008
models.explanation: 3008 is a Peugeot SUV family, with E-3008 identifying an electric product. It belongs on a different body-style shelf from the 308 hatchback.
